sources.title: Government debt at 81.7% of GDP in euro area

facts.claim: EU general government debt was 81.7% of GDP at the end of 2025.
France general government debt was 115.6% of GDP at the end of 2025.
Belgium general government debt was 107.9% of GDP at the end of 2025.
Denmark general government debt was 27.9% of GDP at the end of 2025.
